editorial:
Get ready for a wild ride that will keep you on the edge of your seat. You will follow a group of people who find themselves trapped in a high-stakes game where things go south very quickly. The vibe is super tense and a bit mean, making you feel the stress of the characters as they try to figure out who they can actually trust. It feels like a nightmare that you cannot wake up from, but it is the kind of scary that makes you want to see more. The style is bold and loud, ensuring you never get bored for a single second.

The acting is top-notch and the plot twists will honestly leave you speechless. While the pace moves fast, some might find the violence a bit too much, but that is part of the fun. If you love movies that push boundaries, you need to see this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you discover that the entire setup was a social experiment gone wrong. The main character manages to outsmart the villain in a bloody showdown, turning the tables in a shocking way. After a huge fight, the survivors escape just as the building falls apart. It ends with a final hint that the organization behind the game is still out there, meaning a sequel could happen soon.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gore and unpredictable plot twists.
